name: Intuit Inc.
research_rationale: Q1 beats and cash generation still fit the screen, but softer FY growth guidance, Credit Karma resets and the steep Mailchimp exit temper conviction versus a strong-buy signal.

weekly_updates.summary:
FQ1 (to 31 Oct 2026) revenue of $4.35bn and EPS beat consensus per indexed headlines; FY revenue growth guidance was cut to 8–9% from 9–10%, with Credit Karma outlook reset lower.  
Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.7bn (8-K, 19 Nov); coverage frames a large loss versus the 2021 price and an AI-focused pivot.  
Post-results share fall and mixed analyst revisions (including Mizuho trimming expectations) dominate news since the September verdict.
